title: Catch The Dragon
desc: At the Qing Dynasty's end, Qin Xiaofeng joins a mixed team of dragon hunters led by Xu Yuansheng to find a mysterious dragon and rescue his missing father.

title: King Of Serpant
desc: When Chen Zheng and his friends go to King Serpent Island to collect data on snakes, they encounter evil snake catchers led by Jin Laosi. Will Chen Zheng be able to save the island and its snakes?
